hero.tagline: Backend Engineer, Kotlin / Java on critical banking systems. Paris or remote.

about.title: About
about.text: I have been doing backend work in banking since 2022: legacy you modernise without breaking anything, and rewrites that have to ship. My method does not change, understand the domain first, secure it with tests, rewrite after that. DDD and hexagonal architecture follow from it, they are not boxes ticked at kickoff. I ship my own interfaces too, because a feature that stops at the API is not finished.

jobs.role: Backend Engineer, Kotlin · on assignment at a Groupe BPCE bank
jobs.details:
-Technical ownership of a credit underwriting platform in production: incident analysis, production support, build & run.
-Rewrote back-end APIs in Kotlin / Spring Boot 3 for the sales IS overhaul, compliant with group API standards.
-Contributed to the target architecture: ADRs, hexagonal architecture, clean code.
-Migrated and integrated existing data flows (Apache Camel, Talend) and maintained the Vue.js front-end on the same scope.
-Unit and integration tests, peer code reviews, technical documentation and knowledge sharing.

jobs.role: Fullstack Engineer · alongside the INSEE apprenticeship
jobs.details:
-Designed a NestJS back-end structured with DDD and hexagonal architecture for a lab infrastructure management SaaS.
-Built Python microservices orchestrating UPS and iLO equipment.
-Shipped the Vue 3 front-end and deployment with Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes.
-Led a team of 2 developers: architecture documents, pair programming, code reviews.

-Migrated legacy Talend batch chains to Java 21 / Spring Batch: 12 jobs rewritten, -70% execution time, stronger maintainability, reduced licensing costs.
-Daily releases and CI/CD supervision: application packaging and deployments through GitLab CI coupled with Jenkins.
-JUnit unit tests written test-first on the migration, SonarQube analysis, peer code reviews.
-Ran retrospectives and refinement; application referent for new joiners: onboarding, mentoring, technical support.
